verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a doc line saying ChatGPT's data controls apply to content it processes, including Computer Use screenshots. This implies a user-facing data-usage control exists, but the pack never says that control lets users opt out of model training. The memories controls are a different, adjacent feature and were not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a training opt-out setting, how to enable it and what it covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that opting out works.
